fact: At its inauguration on 3 July 2026 the ST Digital Nkok data centre was stated to be fed by a solar power plant covering about 22 percent of its energy needs, complemented by generators, on 1 MW of installed power.
title: Gabon/Numérique : ST Digital Gabon et le ministère de l'Économie numérique scellent un partenariat stratégique autour du Datacenter de Nkok
